title: fix(app-management): update LND AI apps GitHub link LND78 -> NamanSoni78 (#14033)
author: g33ky00
pr_body_excerpt:
Closes #14033

## What
The issue author asked to update the GitHub profile link for their two apps (LND AI Text to Image, LND AI) from the old profile `LND78` to the current `NamanSoni78`.

This PR changes only the `githubUsername` field for both apps in `operations/app-management/app.json` (`LND78` -> `NamanSoni78`). The generated `/apps` page link (`https://github.com/${githubUsername}`, built by `update-readme.js`) now points to the correct profile.

## Why githubUserId is untouched
Verified via the GitHub API that `NamanSoni78` and the old `LND78` resolve to the **same GitHub user id `170070104`** — this is an account rename, not a new owner. Keeping `githubUserId` preserves internal ownership/metrics matching. `LND78` now returns no user (renamed).

## Scope / safety
- 2 lines changed, 836-app JSON stays valid (verified parse).
- No schema change, no other apps touched — `app.test.js` field validation unaffected.
- `update-readme.js` regenerates the README link in CI from this field, so no separate doc edit is needed.

## Note on existing PR #13981
PR #13981 ("Add NamanSoni78 to the list") is NOT a valid fix: its diff rewrites the entire `app.json` and deletes ~125 apps at the top of the file (fork desynced from main). This PR is the surgical, correct alternative.
